Thanks for the interest, but read this first.

**This repository carries no source.** It holds the documentation, the issue tracker and the
release binaries. The code lives in a private repository.

`README.md`, `SECURITY.md`, `LICENSE` and everything under `docs/` are copied here by a
workflow whenever the private repository changes. A pull request against any of them cannot
be merged, because the next docs push would overwrite it.

If you found a mistake in the documentation, open an issue quoting the line. It gets fixed at
the source and reaches here on the next push, usually the same day.

Pull requests against files under `.github/` are fine.
